name: The Second Coming Of Jesus
overview: Scripture teaches that the Second Coming of Jesus is a future event known only to the Father, emphasizing the need for believers to remain watchful and ready since the Son of Man will come unexpectedly. Jesus comforts His followers by promising to prepare a place for them and to return personally to receive them, assuring that where He is, they will be also. Believers are urged to be vigilant, avoiding the distractions and cares of life that could cause them to be caught unprepared when that day arrives.
